budget_items.topic: Capital request and operating costs in the business plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The business plan calls for $300,000 in capital and projects annual operational costs of $200,000.
budget_items.quote: the business plan calls for $300,000 in capital and projects operational costs at $200,000 annually.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Reducing the franchise fee from 5% to 4.5% would equal $180,000 per year.
budget_items.quote: franchise fee from 5% to 4.5% that equates to $180,000 per year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bringing the fee down to 4.85% was described as not very noticeable overall and possibly more acceptable on the capital request.
budget_items.quote: bringing it down to 4.85% it is not very noticeable overall and may

budget_items.topic: Comparable license: Woburn and lowest fee
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Of the licenses reviewed, the lowest franchise fee was Woburn at 4.625%; at least two were 5% (Fitchburg and Acton).
budget_items.quote: of all the fees, the lowest was woburn was at 4.625...at least two were 5%, fitchburg and acton.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Acton received $366,000 in capital with about 22,000 people in town.
budget_items.quote: acton received $366,000 with 22,000 people in town;

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fitchburg, with a population printed as 40,0000, received $375,000 in capital.

budget_items.topic: Comparable licenses: Woburn and Marlboro capital
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Woburn received $160,000 and Marlboro received $156,0000 (as printed).
The average capital amount was recorded as $100,000 per 10,000 in population.
budget_items.quote: the average is $100,000 per 10,000 in population.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lancaster, with a population printed as $8,000, received $50,000 in 2008; Jo McLaughlin noted it is Lancaster and Sterling under two simultaneous contracts.
budget_items.quote: lancaster with a population of $8,000 received $50,000 in 2008.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Comcast offered $140,000 in capital; the board found the town's number on the high side and sought a compromise.
Tom Alonzo suggested a percentage per subscriber, possibly $75 per year per subscriber, about $.62 per month.
budget_items.quote: possibly $75 per year per subscriber, which works out to $.62 per month.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Jo McLaughlin suggested still going with $240,000 and a 5% fee as the first offer.
budget_items.quote: jo mclaughlin suggested that we should still go with the $240,000 and 5% fee as our first offer.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Offer 1 was year 1 with a 5% franchise fee and $140,000 in capital.
